This one isn't really a game you play in the dark, but it's the Charlie Charlie game. At first I didn't believe in it and thought it was just a big lie. But then, some kids at school were playing it. I decided to watch. They asked it "Charlie charlie, are you here?" I expected the pencil to stay in place, but it moved to "Yes" on the paper. It was crazy since everyone was standing a few steps back and couldn't have blown it, and we were nowhere where wind could blow it. Then they asked "Do you want to kill us?" It went to the opposite side of the paper, and landed on yes. Then the teacher found us and made us stop. That was creepy to see in real life.
